key_insight: ArchOR improves optimization-modeling agents by retrieving reusable skills through structural archetypes rather than relying solely on instance-level similarity.
engineering_relevance: Structure-aware retrieval can help engineering optimization agents select relevant modeling skills when problem narratives vary.
method: CARL refines cached skill representation rankings using a low-rank prototype residual.
S³R prioritizes skills by weighted Jaccard overlap of structural signatures, then semantically re-ranks only the top-K candidates.
Baseline-preserving arbitration decides when structural retrieval should replace the original selector.
evidence_signal: Across five benchmarks, ArchOR achieves 65.00% Micro-Avg. Pass@1 with the same DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone and released skill library, outperforming OptSkills by 1.64 percentage points micro-average and 2.68 points macro-average.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify robustness under narrative rewrites or retrieval overhead, leaving deployment trade-offs uncertain.
paper_title: Structure-Aware Skill Retrieval and Arbitration for Optimization Modeling
